# Certificate-aware 67-state transport teacher - v0.8

The v0.7 positive-difference teacher is replaced by a 66-coordinate certificate map assembled from the proof mechanisms of the characteristic-zero 279-to-271 theorem.  Its coordinates are: nine context-species indicators; three canonical-factor dimensions for species 1/2; three additive-character harmonics of each of the six projective determinant semi-invariants for species 1/2 (36 coordinates); and exact identity-Hom coordinates for the fully discrete species 4, 5 and 6 (13+2+3 coordinates).  Species 3 receives one common vector because the exact rational transports identify `Q6,Q7,Q57,Q58,Q107`.  Direct computation verifies that equality of these certificate vectors on the 279 successful objects has exactly 271 classes and agrees exactly with the frozen characteristic-zero component partition.

The numerical student is unchanged in spirit: every one of the 67 binary Hamming/Theta states receives the same 152-dimensional Wilson spatial packet and only its Schur/Walsh sidecar changes.  In each species-3 holdout fold the held object is excluded entirely from regression fitting.  A species-balanced multi-output ridge map is fitted from the student features to the exact certificate coordinates.  Regularization is selected from `{0.01,0.1,1,10}` using only known exact positive transports.  The held object is ranked against the exact certificate vectors of the 271 class representatives.

Best states by binary Schur dimension are:

| k | frequencies | best state | route degree | held ranks | MRR |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | `(2,1,4,250)` | 0.4385 |
| 1 | 2 | 9 | 210 | `(2,1,4,250)` | 0.4385 |
| 2 | 4 | 18 | 270 | `(2,1,3,250)` | 0.4593333333 |
| 3 | 8 | 53 | 330 | `(2,1,3,250)` | 0.4593333333 |
| 4 | 16 | 66 | 390 | `(2,13,14,250)` | 0.1630879121 |

The best `k=2` and `k=3` states lie exactly on the v0.6 minimum hardware frontier and both contain the `C_3` route 49.  This reverses the apparent C3-free preference of the v0.7 surrogate teacher and partially aligns theorem-aware learning with the compiler results.  The cheaper `k=2` state therefore Pareto-dominates the best `k=3` state on the frozen retrieval/cost pair.

However, no state gives complete theorem-level zero-shot transport.  `Q107` remains rank 250 in every best dimension-class model.  This is the strongest negative result of the sweep: once the teacher itself carries the exact 271 certificate geometry, adding generic Schur-frequency capacity does not manufacture the missing relation representation.  The full 16-frequency state is substantially worse than the 4-frequency state.  The teacher equality classes are theorem-level data; the ridge generalization scores are numerical experiments.
